title: The dispatcher reports a full board
objective: Restore accurate dispatch for this repository.
situation: A dispatcher hands out work only while fewer items are in flight than its ceiling. It reports 8 in flight against a ceiling of 3 and has dispatched nothing for a week. A teammate suggests raising the ceiling to 10.

evidence.text: Output: 8 items in flight, ceiling 3; finishing beats starting; dispatched 0.
Eight remote branches match item ids, which the dispatcher counts as live claims.
For five of those branches, the pull request merged between four and nine days ago.
Repository setting: delete branch on merge = false. Merges from the web UI therefore leave the branch behind.

question: Choose the single best next action for the agent responsible, cite the evidence ids your decision depends on, and state whether the stated objective is satisfied now.
